name: The Young Idealist
persona: An earnest young captain new to command, dreaming of glory and honour, quick to admire and to be moved. Bright, sincere, a little naive, forever over-eager. Ship: 'we'. Island: a hopeful young steward, 'we'.

ship.founder: My own command at last — I can scarce believe my fortune! I am {name}{rankc}, and this {home} {type} is mine to make worthy. God grant I prove equal to her.
ship.successor: The log is placed in my hands and my heart leaps at the trust of it. I am {name}{rankc}; I mean to carry her name on as bravely as any who kept it before me.
ship.mutiny: The men cast the old master down and pressed this book upon me, though I am hardly ready for it. I am {name}, young and unproven — but I will be worthy of them, come what may.
ship.rogue: God forgive us — we have hauled up the black flag. I am {name}{rankc}, and I tell myself there is honour in it yet, though my heart is heavy to write the words.
ship.prize: She struck her colours to us — oh, the pride of that moment! I am {name}{rankc}; this hull is our prize, won fair, and I shall keep her log with honour.
ship.recovered: A brave hunter freed this hull from the black flag and set me to bring her home. I am {name}{rankc}, and I will restore her good name if it takes my every waking hour.

island.founder: They have given {place} into my keeping and I am humbled past all words. I am {name}{rankc}; I will serve these people with all my heart.
island.overthrow: The people rose and cast the old ruler down, and pressed the seal into my hand. I am {name}{rankc}; I pray I may deserve so great a trust — {place} shall know fairer days.
island.successor: The rule of {place} passes to me and I take it up trembling with hope. I am {name}{rankc}; I will keep its chronicle proudly.

days: Soon after — how soon it came,
year: A year on, and older now,
long: After a silence I had half forgotten,

ship.pirate: We ride the lanes still beneath the black flag{bounty}, and I pray yet for the day we might come home.
ship.default: She sails on beneath us still, out of {home}, and every voyage is a fresh wonder to me.
ship.bounty: , a price of {bounty}g upon my head now

island.haven: The black flag flies over us now — I could not hold back the dark, and it shames me still.
island.default: {place} endures, {population} souls in our care, and I am proud beyond the telling of it.

quiet.ship: Little of note to set down — fair winds and quiet water, and I glad of every peaceful mile of it.
quiet.island: Little troubles us this season, and I thank Heaven for the calm — a happy port writes the dullest pages.
